profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Hello, my name is Darian and I am an emerging software engineer with a passion for creating innovative software solutions. My expertise lies in developing Java, Angular, and React applications and utilizing continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines using Jenkins, Pivotal Cloud Foundry, Tekton, and Google Cloud Platform.

I am a highly motivated and dedicated individual with a strong work ethic and a desire to continuously learn and improve my skills. My experience includes intensive training at Ford Credit working on various projects, where I have contributed to the development, testing, and deployment of software applications.

In my free time, I enjoy exploring new technologies and experimenting with different programming languages. I am also an active member of the tech community and enjoy attending technology events.

If you are looking for a software engineer who is committed to delivering high-quality software solutions and has a passion for innovation, then please don't hesitate to contact me. I would love to connect with like-minded individuals and explore potential opportunities.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
I’m a passionate Full Stack Developer at Ford Motor Company, where I design and implement scalable web applications. With a solid foundation in Java/Spring Boot on the back end and both Angular and React/Next.js with Tailwind CSS on the front end, I bridge the gap between robust server-side services and engaging, responsive user experiences.

What I do:

Architect & Build: Develop microservice-based APIs in Java/Spring Boot, ensuring high performance, security, and maintainability.

Front-end Excellence: Craft pixel-perfect, accessible UIs using React, Next.js, Angular, and Material UI, optimized for desktop and mobile.

Cloud & DevOps: Automate CI/CD pipelines with Tekton and Jenkins; deploy containerized workloads on Kubernetes and Cloud Run; manage infrastructure as code with Terraform.

Collaboration & Leadership: Partner cross-functionally with UX designers, QA engineers, and product owners to translate complex requirements into elegant solutions. Consult with fellow engineers, conduct code reviews, and champion best practices in testing and documentation.

Key achievements:

Spearheaded a rollout of a real-time analytics dashboard used by 200+ internal stakeholders, reducing data access latency by 40%.

Migrated monolithic services to a microservices architecture in Google Cloud, improving deployment speed and system reliability.

Implemented end-to-end encryption and OAuth2-based authentication to enhance security across customer-facing applications.

I’m always looking to explore emerging technologies—whether it’s integrating three.js for immersive experiences or leveraging predictive analytics in business workflows. Let’s connect if you’re interested in collaborating on innovative web solutions or discussing the future of automotive software!
